description: This file contains serialization and deserialization functions for objects, including handling of functions, references, and special object types, used within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: FunctionRef
classes.description: Type representing a reference to a function with an ordinal identifier.

methods.name: isFunctionRef
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a FunctionRef.

methods.name: wrapObject
methods.description: Serializes an object, replacing functions with references.

methods.name: unwrapObject
methods.description: Deserializes an object, replacing references with callable functions or imported references.

methods.name: transformObject
methods.description: Recursively transforms an object based on a mapping function.

methods.name: transformObjectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously transforms an object based on a mapping function.
